SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

File No.
Section & Station
3069.
Date January 28, 1932.
28 - 1 - 32.

Subject (in full) Russian Navigation School.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the Officer i/c Special Branch memo of
January 8, on the subject of the Russian Navigation School,
inquiries show that this institution has been organized by the
'Seamen's Group' of the National Religious Society, which is
under the chairmanship of ex-naval Lieutenant Butzkoy.
Ex-Admiral M. Feurovich, a graduate of the Russian Imperial
Naval Academy who recently arrived in Shanghai from Harbin, at
the request of the above society, has been appointed director of
the school and is at present in charge of its affairs. The
school was inaugurated on November 30, 1931, and shares premises
with the Russian Commercial School, No.13 Route Doumer.
So far thirty pupils have been enrolled and classes will
commence on January 25, under the guidance of a teaching staff of
thirteen instructors, including one Chinese.
The complete course will last three years and is divided
as follows:-
First year students will receive training as sailors,
quartermasters, firemen and engineers.
Second year students will be taught to take command of
vessels operating on inland waterways.
Third year students will be trained for the command of
ocean going vessels.
Diplomas for the above mentioned courses will be given
only after practical training has been completed as required by
Russian Law.

[Handwritten note:] Gran Makui. I th rules and regulations of th school are drafted. SBR. G Tcheremshansky

Officer i/c Special Branch. [Signature] D. S.
20/1/32

报告

事由（全称）俄国航海学校。

制作人 D.S. Tcheremshansky。转呈人 [签名]

兹就特别支部主管警官于1月8日关于俄国航海学校事宜的备忘录，经查询显示，该机构由“全国宗教协会”之“海员小组”组织成立，该小组由前海军中尉布茨科伊（Butzkoy）担任主席。前海军少将 M. Feurovich（音译），系俄罗斯帝国海军学院毕业生，近期从哈尔滨抵沪，应上述协会请求，已被任命为该校校长，目前负责校务。该校于1931年11月30日正式开学，校址暂设于杜美路（Route Doumer）13号，与俄国商业学校共用校舍。
截至目前已招收学生三十名，课程将于1月25日开始，由包括一名华人在内的十三名教员组成的教学团队指导。
完整学制为期三年，划分如下：-
第一年学生将接受水手、舵手、司炉和轮机员的训练。
第二年学生将学习指挥在内河航道运营的船只。
第三年学生将接受远洋船只指挥的训练。
上述课程的文凭仅在按照俄国法律要求完成实践训练后方予颁发。

[手写批注：] Gran Makui（音译）。我认为学校的规章制度已起草完毕。特别支部报告。G Tcheremshansky

特别支部主管警官。[签名] D. S.
1932年1月20日

Rules and Regulations governing the Russian Navigation School.

1) Russian Navigation School has been established to prepare
young men for service on board ships. The course will be
of three years duration.

2) Teaching will occupy from 7 to 8 months during the year with
an interruption during the summer when practical teaching
in navigation on board a ship or in a special camp will
take place. (Some of the Russian captains employed with
various steamship companies have consented to take pupils
on board their ships for training)

3) Students upon admission to the school must be 16 years of
age and above and physically fit (strict medical
examination will take place).

4) The lectures will be given during the evening. At the
end of every quarter refresher courses will be held.
Examinations will be held before representatives of the
administration of the school and steamship companies.

5) The uniform of the school will be similar to that of the
Imperial Russian Navy and on the ribbon of the cap will be
printed in Russian, "Russian Navigation School".

6) Fees for tuition is $15 per month for the 1st year, $20
per month for the 2nd year and $25 per month during the
3rd year.

The motto of the school is "Country and Fleet", and the
students are not allowed to participate in any political
movement nor are the men to be members of political parties.
They must devote their whole time and attention to their
studies and remember that their mother country needs the
services of expert seamen and not politicians. A know-
ledge of science is the best way to serve the country.

7) In preparing themselves to be seamen the students are
obliged to study and acquaint themselves with the
traditions of the Russian Navy and Mercantile Marine.

俄国航海学校管理规章。

1) 俄国航海学校的设立旨在为青年男子从事船上服役做准备。学制为期三年。

2) 每年授课时间为7至8个月，夏季中断，期间将在船上或专门营地进行航海实践教学。（受雇于各家轮船公司的部分俄国船长已同意接收学生上船受训）

3) 学生入学时须年满16岁且身体健康（将进行严格的体检）。

4) 讲座安排在晚间进行。每季度末将举行复习课程。考试将在学校行政代表及轮船公司代表面前举行。

5) 校服样式类似于俄罗斯帝国海军制服，帽带上将以俄文印有“俄国航海学校”字样。

6) 学费为第一年每月15元，第二年每月20元，第三年每月25元。

该校校训为“祖国与舰队”，学生不得参与任何政治运动，亦不得加入任何政党。他们必须将全部时间和精力投入学业，并铭记其祖国需要的是专业海员而非政客。掌握科学知识是报效祖国的最佳途径。

7) 学生在准备成为海员的过程中，有义务学习并熟悉俄罗斯海军及商船队的传统。
